_meta.companion: data/telescopes/sdss.md (same content as Markdown). Structure follows elt.json: sources{key: cite, file, url}; sdss: title, telescope, explorer_preset (the proposed web/tpresets.js entry), params, not_found, conflicts, notes.
_meta.rule: Each value carries src (key into sources), loc and a short verbatim quote from a document saved unmodified under rawdata/telescopes/sdss/. derived = arithmetic done here (shown). alternatives = other sourced values. figure_readoff = a value read off a saved figure (the caption is checked). INFERRED marks a reasoned guess no source states. NOT FOUND marks a gap. Nothing is filled from memory.
_meta.quote_normalization: Unicode NFKC; curly quotes, primes, dashes, minus, multiplication sign (to x), degree-like glyphs, division slash, tilde operator, approximately-equal sign, middle dot, plus-minus (to +/-), no-break space and soft hyphen normalized; whitespace collapsed; a quote also passes against the text with PDF line-end hyphenation removed or closed up, or with all whitespace removed; " ... " joins non-adjacent pieces.
_meta.texts_checked: pdftotext -layout and -raw per page and across consecutive page pairs (PDF p. = page index of the saved PDF); HTML as tag-stripped text (tags to a space, tags removed) and raw source (UTF-8); .py as is; the e-print tarball's .tex member.

explorer_preset.primaryNote: A Hextek borosilicate honeycomb mirror, nearly hyperbolic (conic −1.285), radius of curvature 11.25 m (f = 5.62 m, f/2.25 on the nominal 2.5 m), with a 1.17 m central hole; a 2.52 m stop just above the mirror masks the turned edge of the mirror. notes: The three explorer foci share one pupil and one primary-secondary pair; they differ in the correctors, the secondary spacing (3646.14, 3644.46, 3645.17 mm) and the focal surface (0.759, 0.757, 0.776 m behind the primary's vertex).
APOGEE (2011-2020 on plug plates, now on the robots) and BOSS share the f/5 focus; the APOGEE spectrograph preset is in data/round5/apogee.md (same G06 and W19 files).
The obstruction grows off axis (31.8% at 1.5 deg) because the conical and primary baffles emerge from the secondary-baffle shadow beyond 0.5-0.7 deg; the explorer pupil is the on-axis one.
The roll-off enclosure and the wind baffle sit outside the beam; the wind baffle's central disk lies in the secondary's shadow (APOA excludes it from the 28.6%).
